summary: Iteration 7 (Roadmap Templates + Scheduled Nudges cron + owner_email) tested end-to-end on https://transition-map-1.preview.emergentagent.com. Backend: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration7.py with 14 pytest cases across 5 classes — all 14 PASSED. Covers: (a) POST /organizations/{id}/roadmap-template on o-conf with areas=['legal'] creates 3 draft/discovery/template=true initiatives with phases [1,2,3], second call returns created=0 skipped=3 (idempotent), viewer@bots.demo → 403 on o-northwind; (b) POST /cron/checkpoint-nudges → 401 (no auth), 401 (wrong bearer), 200 {ok:true,queued:true} with correct WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET bearer; (c) PUT /entities/{id} with data.owner_email='delivered@resend.dev' persists (GET confirms, restored to prior value afterwards); (d) Regression: /organizations/o-northwind/reminders still shows Sales Co-Pilot m6; stages default list, portfolio pf-a analytics, viewer isolation (403 on o-conf entities), org analytics all 200. Frontend: logged in as isolated@bots.demo (Confidential Corp) → nav-roadmap → Transformation Roadmap view shows 'Seed roadmap template' button (data-testid roadmap-seed-template); first click toast exactly 'Seeded 30 draft initiatives (Co-Pilot → Brain → Autonomous per area).' and matrix fills to 35 road-item cards (Phase 1 Co-Pilots / Phase 2 Brains / Phase 3 Autonomous columns, all with Planned Initiative badge); second click toast exactly 'Template already seeded — nothing to add.' (idempotency confirmed). Opened first road-item → dtab-Responsibilities → drawer-edit-btn → edit-owner_email input present and editable → drawer-save-btn persisted. All seeded template initiatives on o-conf (33 total, incl. prior backend test leftovers) archived at end via POST /entities/{id}/archive, and Cf Transformation owner_email restored to empty so demo data stays clean.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py roadmap-template seed does not DELETE/archive previously-created template initiatives when re-run with the same areas — once archived, a subsequent re-run would recreate them because the idempotency query filters archived:false. Consider either (a) treating archived-template as 'skipped' too, or (b) exposing a cleanup endpoint. Not a bug, just a sharp edge.

_run_checkpoint_nudges records dedupe keys in db.reminder_sent AFTER iterating send() with try/except per recipient — if send fails for one recipient, we still mark the key as sent and the next cron run will not retry. Consider only marking the key when send succeeds (or recording failure separately).

The seed roadmap-template body is optional and defaults to ALL 11 CANON_KEYS, producing 33 drafts per click. Consider adding a UI area multi-select rather than a one-shot 'seed everything' button; otherwise it is easy to pollute an org (the test observed exactly this: a single click seeded 30 new initiatives on an active org).
/entities uses query param organization_id while almost all other endpoints use /organizations/{id}/... — this inconsistency is historical but worth documenting in an API reference.
cron endpoint uses hmac.compare_digest + Bearer header (good). Consider rate-limiting it anyway in case the token leaks.

seed_data_creation: Side effects of this run, all reverted: (a) backend test seeded 3 template initiatives on o-conf for area 'legal' and archived them in a module teardown; (b) UI test seeded 30 (toast reported) template initiatives on o-conf (all 11 CANON areas × 3, minus 3 pre-existing from the backend fixture); a final cleanup script archived all 33 template initiatives on o-conf and restored owner_email on init-cf-1 to empty. Final GET entities for o-conf shows 0 non-archived template:true initiatives. owner_email on the northwind initiative mutated in TestOwnerEmail was restored to its prior value within the test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 7 verified end-to-end. Reusable file /app/backend/tests/test_iteration7.py (14 tests, parallel-safe). Previous iteration6 regression (/app/backend/tests/test_iteration6.py) still relevant.
